verdict.rationale: The H200 is physical hardware you purchase/own and deploy in your own datacenter or colo, making self-hosting the core product inherently possible (unlike SaaS AI products), and NVIDIA's stack (CUDA toolkit, drivers, Nsight tools) supports fully on-prem deployment across data centers and workstations. missing for 10: no direct documentation of an on-prem purchase/procurement path or hands-on self-hosting case study, and no independent report confirming ease of self-managed deployment outside of cloud providers.
